title: Release Release v2026-01-11
content:
## What's Changed
* docs: fix broken Google Pay Handler link in payment handler guide by @yanheChen in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/4
* chore: add config for ruff by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/33
* chore: add *.code-workspace to .gitignore and .gitignore to cspell ignored files by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/36
* chore: increase verbosity of super-linter by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/42
* chore: allow super-linter to post status checks to PRs by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/43
* chore: more logging and config for linter by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/44
* chore: fix ruff format command args by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/45
* docs: Add salesforce logo to advisory partners folder by @aksbro-gpu in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/46
* fix: updated hosted json refs to correct filenames with absolute paths by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/30
* style: Remove conflicting python lint rules and format with ruff by @drewolson-google in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/52
* fix: update ECP card instrument example objects by @lemonmade in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/26
* style: Fix ruff lint checks by @drewolson-google in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/53
* docs: update Etsy logo to current version by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/57
* chore: correctly set up cspell to use config by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/59
* docs: add enhancement-proposal.md and update CONTRIBUTING.md by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/61
* docs: Refactor GOVERNANCE.md  by @amithanda in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/65
* chore: add mkdocs "mike" plugin config to version documentation by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/106
* docs: define capability maturity levels by @igrigorik in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/86
* docs: add versioning page by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/110
* fix: update git tag to start with v by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/114
* chore: update mike to use a branch instead of release by @wry-ry in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/111

## New Contributors
* @yanheChen made their first contribution in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/4
* @aksbro-gpu made their first contribution in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/46
* @amithanda made their first contribution in https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/65
